sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor “
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

After Installation

  1. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated
  2. Go to Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor → Dashboard to access the dashboard
  3. Enable the widgets you want to use
  4. Start using the widgets in Elementor editor
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes! Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor offers 5 powerful widgets completely free. We also offer a Pro version with additional premium widgets and features.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

No, Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor works with both free and Pro versions of Elementor.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

Not at all! Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor is built with performance in mind. Only the CSS and JS files of enabled widgets are loaded, ensuring optimal performance.

Can I use Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor with any WordPress theme?

Yes, Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor works with any WordPress theme that supports Elementor.

How do I get support?

For free version support, please use the WordPress.org support forum. Pro users get priority support through our dedicated support system.

Can I disable widgets I don’t use?

Absolutely! You can enable or disable individual widgets from the Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor dashboard to optimize performance.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor is fully translation ready and compatible with WPML and other translation plugins.

How often do you update the plugin?

We release updates regularly with bug fixes, improvements, and new features. The plugin includes an automatic update system.

Does voice input work in Bangla/Bengali language?

Yes! We support both Bangla (Bangladesh) and Bangla (India) variants. Users can select their preferred Bangla dialect from the language selector. Voice input works perfectly for Bengali speakers!

Which languages are supported for voice input?

We support 26+ languages: English (US, UK, AU, CA), Bangla (Bangladesh, India), Spanish (Spain, Mexico), French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil, Portugal), Russian, Chinese (Simplified, Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, and more!

Does voice input work on mobile devices?

Yes! Voice input works perfectly on mobile devices (smartphones and tablets) running Chrome, Safari, or Edge browsers. It’s actually faster than typing on mobile!

Is voice input free or do I need Pro version?

Voice input is 100% FREE! All voice input features, including 26+ languages, user language selector, and voice-enabled forms are included in the free version.

Can I create custom post types without coding?

Absolutely! Our Custom Post Types Manager lets you create unlimited CPTs with 8 custom field types through a visual interface – no coding required whatsoever.

Will this work with my theme?

Yes! Advanced Widget Kit works with any WordPress theme that supports Elementor. It’s theme-independent and compatible with all popular themes.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! You can use our widgets on WooCommerce pages. The Pro version includes dedicated WooCommerce widgets for enhanced eCommerce functionality.

Can I use voice input for languages like Hindi, Arabic, Chinese?

Yes! We support Hindi (India), Arabic (Saudi Arabia), Chinese (Mandarin – Simplified & Traditional), Japanese, Korean, and many other languages.

Is there a limit on number of custom post types?

No! You can create unlimited custom post types with unlimited custom fields in the free version. No restrictions!

Does voice input require any API key or external service?

No! Voice input uses the browser’s built-in Web Speech API. No API keys, no external services, no additional costs. It’s completely free and privacy-friendly!

Is my data secure with voice input?

Yes! Voice processing happens locally in the user’s browser using the Web Speech API. No audio data is sent to our servers. It’s completely secure and privacy-compliant.

Can users with disabilities use voice input?

Absolutely! Voice input is WCAG compliant and perfect for users with visual impairments, motor disabilities, or typing difficulties. It’s a powerful accessibility feature!
